* Style: Reviewers liked the look of the shoes.

It's worth noting that the sample size of reviews is relatively small, so it's hard to draw definitive conclusions. top_reviews.title: Not durable. Definitely not worth the price.
top_reviews.text: The shoes look nice and they are very comfortable but I bought these shoes in August and it’s December and they are already wearing holes in the backs of them. I frequent the gym and am an avid runner but have never had this happen this soon with Nikes. I took a risk trying something new and paid the price.... literally. $220. Not worth it. I’m hoping the company will replace them since my return window is closed.

top_reviews.title: Glad I switched
top_reviews.text: Bought these to replace a pair of running shoes from another major brand bc if knee and hip pain. So far so good. Very well cushioned. Absorbs a lot of shock. Comfortable. Tie bed a little wider than what I’m used to, but length is true to size. Looks good on.
